name: Cáñar (Spain)
description: Green field with three equal zigzag horizontal stripes across the centre, white, blue and white.
history: Cáñar adopted its arms and flag officially on 18 September 2007; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of a green cloth with three equal broken horizontal stripes, two white and one blue, at the centre of the flag.

features.role: three zigzag (broken) stripes across the centre
